rationale: C24 is a concrete antecedent for the child: it addresses the same person, establishes his leadership of the same Commission on National Goals, defines the desired report and its timing, and thanks him for undertaking the assignment. The child functions as a progress-stage follow-up, revisiting the speed of the project, the expected December report, the Commission's substantive purpose, and gratitude for the assignment. These shared specifics and the parallel commissioning/follow-up structure materially exceed generic letter boilerplate. C11 and C07 have weaker report-and-thanks structures but lack the same project and recipient.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Dear Henry: I was very happy to receive your letter ... outlining the progress and work of the Commission on National Goals.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Dear Henry: I am glad to learn that you have agreed to accept the Chairmanship of the Commission on National Goals
shared_material.explanation: Same addressee and exact institutional project; the child is naturally drafted as a follow-up to the earlier commissioning letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you now think it will be possible to have a report by December
shared_material.parent_excerpt: While I would hope that your report could be completed before my term of office is ended
shared_material.explanation: Both letters expressly discuss the anticipated completion timing of the Commission's report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: your committee has the opportunity to make an historic addition to our knowledge and understanding of the democratic processes and our national ideals and purposes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the panel will develop a broad outline of coordinated national policies and programs ... and ... set up a series of goals in various areas of national activity
shared_material.explanation: The child restates and elevates the same substantive purpose assigned to the Commission in C24.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Again, my sincerest thanks for undertaking this most vital assignment.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: With many thanks for your willingness to undertake this important assignment.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively close closing language adapts the earlier thanks for accepting the assignment into thanks for carrying it forward.
